query: Compare the listed causes for startup memory read errors on IV-HG500CA and IV4-G600CA.
expected_snippet: Column headers: Cause; Row headers: Sensor program damaged. Initialization necessary. > [Initialize] button displayed. > Sensor program xx is damaged. Initialization is necessary.  | Column headers: Cause; Row headers: ON; Cell value: A startup memory read error occurred. • A data abnormality occurred due to noise or because the power switched OFF while writing

table_row_headers: Sensor program xx is damaged. Initialization is necessary. [Initialize] button will be displayed.

expected_evidence.equivalent_citation_policy: Same source-document IV-HG500CA table-cell or row-group citations are acceptable only when the cited chunk content directly states a startup memory read error cause for the IV-HG/IV-HG500CA side, including either sensor-program damage requiring initialization or data abnormality due to noise/power-off during writing. Generic memory-error output descriptions without the cause relation do not satisfy this role.
expected_evidence.label: IV-HG500CA
expected_evidence.snippet: Column headers: Cause; Row headers: Sensor program damaged. Initialization necessary. > [Initialize] button displayed. > Sensor program xx is damaged. Initialization is necessary.

expected_evidence.equivalent_citation_policy: Same source-document IV4-G600CA table-cell or row-group citations are acceptable only when the cited chunk content directly states the IV4 sensor-startup/nonvolatile-memory read cause, including data error and power-off/noise during writing. Generic error-output rows without the cause relation do not satisfy this role.
expected_evidence.label: IV4-G600CA
